description: This file contains utility functions related to Webservices in vtiger CRM, including functions for handling entity IDs, user/group access, version retrieval, entity management, transfer of ownership and related records, language translations, and webservice operation registration.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Represents a webservice entity object, providing methods to instantiate from name or ID, and to get entity details.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Acts as an abstract class representing CRM entities, with a static method to get instances by module name.

classes.name: WebServiceException
classes.description: Exception class for web service related errors, with error code constants.

methods.name: vtws_getUsersInTheSameGroup
methods.description: Fetches all users in the same groups as the specified user.

methods.name: vtws_generateRandomAccessKey
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length for access keys.

methods.name: vtws_getVtigerVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current version of vtiger CRM from the database.

methods.name: vtws_getUserAccessibleGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups accessible to a user for a given module.

methods.name: vtws_getWebserviceGroupFromGroups
methods.description: Converts group IDs to webservice entity IDs.

methods.name: vtws_getUserWebservicesGroups
methods.description: Returns webservice group representations for a user and module.

methods.name: vtws_getIdComponents
methods.description: Splits a composite ID into its components.

methods.name: vtws_getId
methods.description: Constructs a composite ID from entity ID and record ID.

methods.name: getEmailFieldId
methods.description: Retrieves the email field ID for a given entity meta object.

methods.name: vtws_getParameter
methods.description: Safely retrieves a parameter value from an array, with optional default.

methods.name: vtws_getEntityNameFields
methods.description: Fetches name fields for a given module for entity display.

methods.name: vtws_getModuleNameList
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that are entities.

methods.name: vtws_getWebserviceEntities
methods.description: Retrieves all webservice entities and distinguishes modules and entities.

methods.name: vtws_getModuleInstance
methods.description: Gets an instance of CRMEntity corresponding to the webservice object.

methods.name: vtws_isRecordOwnerUser
methods.description: Checks if the owner ID corresponds to a user.

methods.name: vtws_isRecordOwnerGroup
methods.description: Checks if the owner ID corresponds to a group.

methods.name: vtws_getOwnerType
methods.description: Returns whether the owner ID belongs to a user or group.

methods.name: vtws_runQueryAsTransaction
methods.description: Executes a database query within a transaction context.

methods.name: vtws_getCalendarEntityType
methods.description: Determines if a record is a Calendar or an Event based on activity type.

methods.name: vtws_getWebserviceEntityId
methods.description: Returns a webservice entity ID string for an entity name and ID.

methods.name: vtws_addDefaultModuleTypeEntity
methods.description: Registers a module as a webservice entity with module type.

methods.name: vtws_addModuleTypeWebserviceEntity
methods.description: Adds a module as a webservice entity linked to handler class and file.

methods.name: vtws_deleteWebserviceEntity
methods.description: Removes a module/webservice entity by name.

methods.name: vtws_addDefaultActorTypeEntity
methods.description: Registers an actor (like a related module) as a webservice entity.

methods.name: vtws_addActorTypeWebserviceEntityWithName
methods.description: Adds an actor entity with specific name fields and details.

methods.name: vtws_addActorTypeWebserviceEntityWithoutName
methods.description: Adds an actor entity without specific name fields.

methods.name: vtws_addActorTypeName
methods.description: Associates name fields and table for an actor webservice entity.

methods.name: vtws_getName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name for an entity ID.

methods.name: vtws_preserveGlobal
methods.description: Preserves a global variable state.

methods.name: vtws_addWebserviceOperation
methods.description: Registers a new webservice operation with handler details.

methods.name: vtws_addWebserviceOperationParam
methods.description: Adds parameters to a webservice operation.

methods.name: vtws_getModuleHandlerFromName
methods.description: Loads module handler object using module name.

methods.name: vtws_getModuleHandlerFromId
methods.description: Loads module handler object using module ID.

methods.name: vtws_CreateCompanyLogoFile
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving a company logo file.

methods.name: vtws_getActorEntityName
methods.description: Fetches actor names based on entity name and ID list.

methods.name: vtws_getActorEntityNameById
methods.description: Fetches actor names by entity ID and list of IDs.

methods.name: vtws_isRoleBasedPicklist
methods.description: Checks if a picklist is role-based.

methods.name: vtws_getConvertLeadFieldMapping
methods.description: Retrieves mapping for converting lead fields.

methods.name: vtws_getRelatedNotesAttachments
methods.description: Copies notes and attachments related to a lead to another entity.

methods.name: vtws_saveLeadRelatedProducts
methods.description: Associates lead's products with another entity.

methods.name: vtws_saveLeadRelations
methods.description: Associates lead's relations with other records.

methods.name: vtws_transferLeadRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers all lead-related records to a new entity.

methods.name: vtws_transferComments
methods.description: Transfers comments between records.

methods.name: vtws_transferOwnership
methods.description: Changes ownership from old to new owner, updating all dependencies.
